pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.fixedDefault: Products stay fixed until an administrator saves a dynamic policy. Enabling renewal pricing applies automatically to future renewals.
pricing.legacyProtected: When enabled, dynamic pricing applies to future renewals automatically. Completed charges and paid traffic remain unchanged.
pricing.saveError: Pricing could not be saved. Reload to check the latest version.
pricing.invalid: Check the limits and enter a reason.
pricing.emptyRecords: No retained records in this scope.
pricing.originalForecasts: Solid: observed actuals. Dashed: the original saved prediction. Shading: P10–P90. Missing and censored windows are excluded from accuracy metrics. Each line uses one model and one lead-time band.
pricing.noForecasts: No original forecasts match this entity, horizon and model. New forecasts will appear after the scheduled worker records them.
pricing.exportScopeHint: Export every retained, authorized record in the selected scope. No date filter exports the full retained range. Archives include typed schema, lineage, row counts and checksums. Browsers with a native save picker stream directly to disk. Other browsers support downloads up to 32 MiB; narrow the scope for larger datasets.
pricing.pseudonymize: Pseudonymize user identifiers with stable joins
pricing.authorizeSensitive: Authorize this user/financial export for this browser session and scope.
pricing.exportComplete: Export downloaded. The manifest documents retained coverage and file checksums.
pricing.exportError: Export could not complete. Retry with a smaller scope or wait for the active export.
pricing.retentionHint: Source history may already have expired. Raw machine telemetry, connection IPs and credentials are never included. Forecast details retain 90 days; exposure and candidate details retain 60 days; compact validation summaries retain 12 months.
pricing.healthHint: Charts collect only while this page is open. Sustained overload and recovery thresholds prevent brief spikes from changing pricing. Unknown monitoring is shown separately from confirmed outages.
pricing.storagePressure: Storage pressure has paused discretionary pricing calculations. Billing and existing entitlements continue.
pricing.userFeatures: Seven-day node usage and behavioral features
pricing.automaticLimits: Bounds are calculated from validated response, cost and capacity data. A bounded price search keeps candidates within 95% of the best expected contribution. Without sufficient evidence the automatic change is 0%. Explicit administrator rates and budgeted campaigns remain available.
pricing.renewalAutomatic: Dynamic pricing applies automatically to future renewals. We notify you about price changes. Coupons and rewards retain priority. Health delays grant no extra access and last at most 72 hours.
pricing.financeScope: Recorded results cover the last 30 days: commerce charges minus entitlement credits. Costs include only explicitly recorded provider payments and may be incomplete. Forecasts cover the next UTC day, before refunds, and remain unvalidated until measured. Missing costs are unavailable, not zero.
pricing.workerSummary: Dynamic products: {dynamic} · Pricing jobs: {pending} pending, {failed} failed · Administrative changes in 30 days: {changes}
pricing.responseEvidence: These are the original candidate probabilities and contributions. Prior-only and unvalidated results are diagnostic and do not establish causal elasticity.
pricing.noCalibration: No completed probability windows have been summarized yet.
pricing.recordProviderPayment: Also record an actual provider payment
pricing.quoteChanged: The price changed. Review the refreshed total before confirming.

quoteStates.delayed: The calculation is taking longer. Retry when ready.
quoteStates.stale: This quote expired. Refresh it before confirming.
quoteStates.unavailable: Your price could not be prepared. Please retry.

pricing.partialRecords: More records are available. Load the next page to continue.
pricing.eventsUnavailable: Event history is unavailable; forecasts remain available.
pricing.invalidDates: Choose a valid date range with the end after the start.

reasons.PRICE_SUPPORT_MISSING: Price is outside the supported range
reasons.COUPON_NET_REVENUE: Best owned coupon included in the estimate
reasons.CAPACITY_UNSAFE: Capacity evidence does not support admission
reasons.OPTIMUM_SELECTED: Stable price within the contribution envelope
reasons.OPERATIONAL_REFUSAL: Operational checks prevent an automatic adjustment
reasons.MACHINE_CAPACITY_UNSAFE: A fulfilling machine has insufficient capacity
reasons.RENEWAL_HEALTH_DEFERRED: Renewal is delayed by node health

pricing.basketEstimate: Basket estimate after best owned coupon
pricing.estimateHint: Model estimate for the basket using the best eligible owned coupon once. Your selected coupon and final payable total are shown separately.
